tiktok.author: yourrealestatebestie1
tiktok.body:
My yard sign answered a buyer last night while I was asleep. 😴📲 No sign-call service. No dynamic QR fees. No lead forms strangers won’t fill out. I built this automation FREE with apps already on your phone — buyer scans, a text sends itself, my phone replies in seconds with the price, pics, and link… and their number lands in my Messages automatically. This is the future of real estate and most agents have no idea it’s possible. 🤯 The full step-by-step build (screen recording + scripts + the guide) is inside the Marketing Manor — workshop link in my bio 🔑 Let me know what questions you have below 👇 #realtortok #realestateagent #realtormarketing #realestatemarketing #realtortips
At 9:47 last night, a buyer slowed down in front of my listing, scanned my sign, and a text wrote itself. And my phone answered them automatically. Price, photos and the link was sent to them. I was already in bed. No app, no monthly fee. I built it for free on my phone. And the best part? The second they hit send, their number landed in my messages like a curbside concierges

tiktok.author: realtortalkswithasg
tiktok.body:
ChatGPT and Google are the new leads!  #realestate #realtortips #realestatemarketing #realtor
I don't believe in gatekeeping, so let me tell you exactly how I started getting clients without chasing anyone because I was struggling for a while. I got a call from a buyer last month and he said yeah, chat G. P. T. Actually recommended you. I almost dropped the phone because even though I know people are using chat G. B. P. All the time now, I didn't think I'd ever come up in a chat G. B. P. Search. It turns out that some local blog posts that I had written about the neighbourhoods in my area are what chat G. P. T. And Google pull from when someone asks who's a good agent in the area. And that's the secret that nobody's talking about being the agent who shows up when people search so that they find you instead of you chasing them. The thing is, is that I was not writing this blog post because I didn't have the time to write this blog post because I was out in the field doing realtor work. But if you are looking for an app that does it all for you like it did it all for me, I recommend using an app called Trolto. Trolto actually wrote those local blog posts for Chat G. P. T. And Google. They do all of my content, marketing, and they even built my agent website. If you're interested in that, follow along for more.
